test: Section-link behavior in real desktop browser binaries at desktop and mobile viewport widths

method.resolutions: 1440 × 900 light with normal motion; 390 × 844 dark with reduced motion. Firefox uses a native desktop session with the equivalent viewport.
method.activation: Activates a published Contents link by keyboard, repeats by pointer, then follows a different Contents target. Direct entry uses a fresh document. The cross-article link is the existing remediation script reference in the Autorun article.
method.otherFragment: The published site has no authored HTML footnotes. An ordinary fixture link to its existing #main-content landmark tests exclusion of non-heading fragments.
method.graph: Chrome and Brave received cached copies of the original D3 and Pixi assets on Home. Firefox used the normal browser resource path. Counts are snapshots of cold Home visits, not graph-refresh investigations.

result: All automated assertions passed on both builds in all six browser and preference combinations.
